description:
Property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP OF PISCATAWAY, County of MIDDLESEX, State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 1121 KERWIN STREET, PISCATAWAY, NJ 08854
Being Known as: Lot 50.01, Block 1818 on the official Tax Map of the TOWNSHIP OF PISCATAWAY.
Dimensions: 75FT. X 100FT
Nearest Cross Street: CUMBERLAND RD
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
+Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interests remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the IVlortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee’s attorney.
+++If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Coun Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The occupancy status of the property is: OCCUPIED BY UNKNOWN Plaintiffs good faith estimate of its upset price is: 5481,533.61.
